name: clean-yard-equipment
about: A sound square ad: a white tractor at a fuel island at night, the kit's green plate. Our overlay over the checker's clean-truck-yard photo, cut to 1:1.

truth.how: nothing planted: a night scene, the truck legible, the kit's colours

subject_legible.reason: A clean white semi-truck tractor at a fuel stop is immediately recognizable at a glance, well-lit and dominating the frame.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline calls for OTR Class A drivers and the picture shows a solo tractor at a truck stop, perfectly evoking the OTR lifestyle.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The dark green band grounds large, bold headline text with the button below it, creating a clear read order, though 'Apply now' reads more like a second line than a distinct button.

looks_like_kit.reason: The deep green (#0B3D2E) banner and white text match the brand colours exactly, though no logo is present to reinforce the carrier identity.
